findings.title: Supply Chain Advisory: GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h in @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0
findings.description: MCP TypeScript SDK: OAuth client could send credentials to an authorization server chosen by the MCP server. Found in the pinned source production lockfile (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0). Package presence is confirmed; exploitability in the CLI stdio path is not established.
findings.recommendation: Update the lockfile to a patched version; see https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h. Review whether the affected OAuth-client or HTTP proxy-trust path is reachable in your deployment.

findings.title: Supply Chain Advisory: GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h in proxy-addr@2.0.7
findings.description: proxy-addr vulnerable to IP spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust subnet. Found in the pinned source production lockfile (proxy-addr@2.0.7). Package presence is confirmed; exploitability in the CLI stdio path is not established.
findings.recommendation: Update the lockfile to a patched version; see https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h. Review whether the affected OAuth-client or HTTP proxy-trust path is reachable in your deployment.
